descriptionHtml:
A panel discussion based on the life story of an engineer from academic life to the next step they have taken after graduating. The audience will have the opportunity to meet 4 individuals who share their own real-life experiences. And also we would be able to have access to successful, working professionals within our field. Furthermore, if we are interested, we'll have internships and job opportunities with leading companies and organizations.

Panelists

Prof. J.B. Ekanayake

Dr. Maheshi Dissanayake

Dr. Ruwan Ranaweera

Eng. Anuradha Udunuwara
